execution_notes: Only concurrent scan, edit-during-scan, interrupted/recovery and 25-post sequential regressions executed.
First harness attempt rejected a marker before any save/scan; corrected runner then passed 87 assertions.
Modified standalone doubles were syntax-checked only; their suites were not executed.
Earlier 200/1000-post benchmarks were not rerun and are not measurements of this coordinated runtime.
